name: Dimensions of Joy
notes: Source of truth for tao-24/DesignSystem/*Tokens.swift. Change a value here, mirror it there.

Dark-only by design: the palette is anchored to deep black and has no light counterpart, so the app locks preferredColorScheme(.dark). Adding light mode means adding a 'light' value to every color token.
Every contrast ratio below is measured, not estimated. Re-measure when changing a value.

base.usage: App ground, behind scroll content and under sheets.

surface.usage: Default screen surface. The reference background for all contrast math.

card.usage: Cards and rows lifted off the surface.

overlay.usage: Pressed and hovered states, unfilled progress tracks, sheet grabbers.

onAccent.usage: Label on a filled Health accent.

alternate.note: Higher-vibrancy option from the brief; 11.22 on surface, brighter than the other two domains.

onAccent.usage: Label on a filled Career accent.

alternate.note: Electric cyan option from the brief; 10.40 on surface, considerably louder.

onAccent.usage: Label on a filled Fun accent.

alternate.note: Pink option from the brief. Rejected as default: reads as an error colour on dark, and breaks the Fun-is-orange rule in CLAUDE.md.

muted.note: Lightened twice. The reference grey #6A6A6A measures 3.46 and fails outright. #8A8A8A then passed on the surface but failed at 4.27 on the #282828 overlay, which is where muted text lands inside a pill or pressed row. Every text token is now checked against all four surfaces by ContrastTests.

subtle.usage: Hairline dividers. Rare — luminance separates surfaces first.

strong.usage: Decorative emphasis on a divider. NOT for interactive controls — 1.66:1 on a card.

controlOutline.usage: Resting outline of an interactive control: an unchecked completion ring, an unfilled field.
controlOutline.note: Added after the first run of the Starter Hub. The ring had used border.strong, which measured 1.66:1 against its own card and made the checklist's primary affordance nearly invisible. Checked on all four surfaces by ContrastTests.

positive.usage: Completion confirmed. Shares the Health hue deliberately — one positive language.

notice.usage: Gentle attention. Never for a missed habit.
notice.constraint: There is no negative/error status colour for habit completion. Missing a day is not an error state; see the no-punitive-streaks rule.

fontFamily.primary: SF Pro Display / SF Pro Text (system)
fontFamily.note: The reference face is proprietary. The system face reproduces the weight relationship, not the typeface.

typography.note: Sizes are the @1x default for reference only. Every style is built on its textStyle so it scales with Dynamic Type; never hardcode a point size.

pill.usage: Fully rounded. Domain pills, filter chips.

elevation.note: Dark surfaces separate by luminance, not drop shadows. The only 'elevation' is an accent glow on active elements.

motion.usage: One spring for the whole system. Tactile, not bouncy.
motion.reducedMotion: Honour accessibilityReduceMotion: cross-fade instead of scale/spring.

accessibility.rule: Colour is never the only signal. Every domain accent is paired with a distinct SF Symbol and a text label, because green/blue/orange are hard to separate with deuteranopia.
